## What you co-own (edit + sign)

## Standing rules
1. Always `git pull --ff-only` before you edit notes or code that others may have touched.
2. Do not start LLM seats until the T1 regression gate is green (see tranche scope exit criteria).
3. Advance on gate, not on calendar week labels.
